key_reasoning.reason: New service/headroom package with 9 modules (models, resolver, strategies, compressor protocol, factory, SDK and sidecar compressors, pre-model hook) plus config.py, customer config and docker-compose; introduces a new compressor abstraction. Scoped to slice 1 (core) only.

No exact precedent: fail-open pre-model hook on the LLM path, HTTP sidecar client with Bearer token handling (errors carry only exception types or status codes, never content), lazy SDK import with offline/no-telemetry env, response validation. Enumerated error and edge paths are covered by dedicated test modules.
26 files per diffstat (about 6 modified, about 20 new, roughly half tests and docs), which maps to XXL under the diffstat table. Source-only churn is closer to L, so this dimension overstates effort.
pyproject.toml and poetry.lock changed for the headroom-ai SDK (lazily imported, may be absent) plus a new Headroom sidecar service in docker-compose.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk: security-sensitive aspect (sidecar auth token, content-free error messages) not fully covered by an existing pattern, treated as divergence
Technical Risk: acceptance criteria enumerate error and variant cases (timeouts, non-2xx, non-JSON, malformed responses, message count mismatch); new test modules were required
